segments.text: Is that all?
Yes, madam. I'm sure you'll appreciate that these checks are necessary for security reasons.
So, what exactly is the problem?
Problems?
OK.
Well, first, your computer is clearly malfunctioning.
I paid my last bill in full, but the statement shows that I only paid half of it.
Yes, the account does only show that £200 was paid of the £400 owed.
Yes, but I paid the £400 through my bank account online. I have my receipt.
And my bank statement shows that you have taken £400 out of my bank account.
Oh, I see. What I'll do is check with the bank and see what they say.
OK. You said there was something else.
Unfortunately, there is. My phone account shows that £107.27 was paid on a single phone call to a mobile outside the UK on December 24th.
I don't remember making that call, and I don't recognise the number.
Let's have a look at the details, madam.
Well, it was definitely made from your phone to an overseas number at 10pm on that date.
But I have no recollection of making that call.
Maybe it was to wish someone abroad a happy Christmas, madam.
No, I don't know anyone living abroad.
Oh, wait, hold on.
Yes?
I lent my phone to a friend of my brother's who is an overseas student here.
He desperately wanted to phone home, but had lost his mobile that evening.
My mistake. Sorry.
That's okay, Mrs Williams. Is there anything else?
Well, I don't want to take any more of your time.
Go ahead, madam. That's why I'm here.
Hmm, well, the number of free calls per month seems to have gone down.
Oh, if you look at your statement for November, you will see that the number has actually been increased from 150 to 200 minutes of free calls per month.
This is in line with our competitors.
Oh, yes, I see it now. Thanks. Great.
Was that all, Mrs Williams?
Yes, but you will check that payment made from my bank, won't you?
Yes, madam. Would you like to hold the line, or shall I call you back?
Please call me back on my landline. I'll be at home for the next three hours, but I've got to go out at midday.
Right. What's the number?
it's 0161 112 3975 yes that's it okay I'll phone you straight back thanks
very much bye
